reason: The first actual native preview proved that six cropped gate fragments touched roofs or alpha corners rather than forming a ground-continuous enclosure. They are replaced by real project-native horizontal and longitudinal masonry modules with explicit ground footprints.

protected_existing_scope.unchanged_forecourt_rows: Keep the four grass-stone shoulders and the two admitted peony beds from ART admission C3B0E9C6 exactly unchanged.

vertical_wall.solid_derivation: Metadata used bounds x[-0.65,+0.65]m and z[-2.5,+2.5]m at 64px/m X and 32px/m ground Z, relative to actual support z=2.494m. This is the real longitudinal ground run, not a sprite-bottom strip.

horizontal_wall.solid_derivation: Metadata used bounds x[-2.5,+2.5]m and z[-0.575,+0.575]m relative to actual support z=0.34375m.

short_86.purpose: Use unchanged central masonry pixels to close only the remaining 86px hall-side interval; no resize or nonuniform scale.

short_125.purpose: Use unchanged central masonry pixels between corridor and gate; no resize or nonuniform scale.

native_sources.license_boundary: Both walls are project-original native masonry captures. Their metadata explicitly says the geometry is not CC0. This author reuses existing pixels/resources only and does not modify either PNG.

layout_logic.explanation: The estate becomes one perimeter instead of six gap patches. The main hall closes the north centre; native horizontal walls run from its sides to the two outer longitudinal walls; each longitudinal wall is four exact 160px ground modules; the existing two corridors plus the gate close the south facade, with one short native horizontal connector at each corridor-to-gate seam. Wings remain inside the enclosure and are not used as fake wall endpoints.

visual_contact_contract: North west/east short walls terminate on the measured main-hall A1 sides x=1156 and x=1916 at its real foot line y=520; no roof-corner-only join.

The west/east side walls overlap the outer corridors in draw depth near y=1000..1160, so the pavilions hide the terminal seam; their real 160px-long ground solids remain continuous behind the corridor bodies.
The two short south walls overlap the gate/corridor lower masonry on y=1120.6..1157.4 and overlap the terminal side-wall solids through the corridor bodies; no open character-width seam is allowed.
Native preview must show a single enclosing outline. Any visible floating wall, roof-only junction, doubled tile ridge, or wall drawn over a building door is a failure.

route_contract.rule: The enclosure deliberately blocks passage through the outer perimeter. Building-door routes stay inside or exit through the existing gate; System must recompute any route that previously crossed the old six isolated wall fragments. Do not preserve a route by weakening the longitudinal wall solids.

actual_acceptance: one native whole-scene preview shows a continuous perimeter around the hall, wings, corridors and gate
vertical modules retain true longitudinal perspective and a 160px ground body; no gate end-cap is reused as a fake side wall
adult-scale wall height is compatible with the gate and does not visually dwarf the one-storey buildings
all three building doors and the central gate opening remain visibly clear
the two admitted peony beds remain correctly scaled and do not intersect the central approach
geometry verifies the new 16 wall solids, affected route replacements and exact inverse restoration before any deployment
scope_boundary: One native candidate successor only. No PNG edit, image generation, import, engine execution by ART, formal deployment, or whole-estate completion credit. The failed six-fragment preview and all AM evidence remain intact.
